news.title: Heavy police presence at SW Atlanta apartment complex
news.summary: Heavy police presence at an apartment complex along McDaniel St SW early Sunday morning.

news.title: Suspect wanted for deadly Atlanta shooting in 2019 arrested in Alabama, police say
news.summary: A man accused of an Atlanta murder was arrested in east Alabama Sept. 16, authorities there say.

news.title: DeKalb Police seize 735 pounds of marijuana, 9 guns in drug bust
news.summary: DeKalb County Police announced on Friday that its officers intercepted a massive out-of-state drug delivery leading to the seizure of more than 700 pounds of marijuana and nearly a dozen firearms.

news.title: Man injured in northwest Atlanta house fire, officials say
news.summary: A man is in the hospital with severe burn injuries after a fire on Saturday morning in northwest Atlanta, officials said.

news.title: 2 injured, family displaced after late-night fire at Clayton County home
news.summary: Two people were injured, and a family is displaced after a house fire erupted in Clayton County late Friday night, fire officials said.

news.title: Man dies in hit-and-run crash on interstate
news.summary: Atlanta police say officers are investigating a hit-and-run crash on the downtown connector that killed a man in the early morning hours of Saturday.

news.title: Man sentenced for 2024 fatal shooting inside Brookhaven tattoo shop
news.summary: A New York man was sentenced to life in prison after a DeKalb County jury convicted him in the fatal shooting inside a Brookhaven tattoo shop, district attorney officials announced.

news.title: Three arrested in $65K East Point apartment rent fraud scheme
news.summary: Three women face multiple charges after allegedly stealing around $65,000 in rent payments from residents at the Fulton Pointe Apartments in East Point.

news.title: Police release video of ‘slowest PIT’ during Sandy Springs chase
news.summary: Sandy Springs police have released video showing a chase that ended with what they said was the city’s slowest PIT.
